title: 第3章 无上剑体恐怖剑意第4章 九彩灵根胖揍七皇子
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
陆尘哼着小曲儿回到元秀殿，便看到母亲正在低头给自己做针线活，给自己做准备过冬的衣裳。
虽然宫中妃子和皇子吃穿用度都由内廷负责，但是在元妃看来，只有自己亲手给儿子缝的衣服才更保暖。
看到这一幕，陆尘脸上不由流露出一丝暖意。
重生到这个世界，从出生到现在。
就是眼前的女人真心实意的爱自己，待自己。
虽然对于陆尘这个穿越者来说，元妃算是便宜老娘。
但是这个女人对自己的爱是真的，陆尘的心哪怕是铁做的，也早就被暖热了。
“尘儿回来了，饿不饿啊，这里有些点心，吃一点。”
看到陆尘，元妃脸上露出了宠溺的笑容开口。
“娘亲！”
陆尘来到了元妃旁边。抱住了元妃的胳膊。
“娘亲，明天测试体质，根脚和悟性，尘儿一定努力，让皇宫中的人，让父皇看到孩儿，孩儿更会努力修炼，努力变强，以后有孩儿在，谁也不能瞧不起娘亲！”
陆尘情真意切的开口。
而元妃听到此言，愣了一下，随后眼中含泪，一把紧紧的抱住了陆尘，脸上更是露出了欣慰和开心的笑容。
“尘儿，对于娘亲来说，只要你好好的，就比什么都强！”
【恭喜你。完成任务，让你母亲露出了真心实意的笑容。】
【恭喜你，获得无上剑体！】
而这个时候，陆尘耳边再次传来了只有自己才能听到的声音。
而伴随着这道声音，陆尘身上突然爆发出恐怖的剑意。
就在这一刹那间，整个皇宫无数的宝剑都整齐划一的兴奋的轻吟一秒钟。

时间非常短，并没有引得太多人的注意。
而中极殿，正在修炼的青帝却是突然睁开了眼睛，看着一旁跟随着自己征战数十年的无上至宝青帝剑竟然莫名其妙的轻吟一声，青帝却是微微皱眉。
“怪哉，今天竟然出现两次异象，最重要的是，朕竟然都无法察觉，朕这皇宫，究竟发生了什么？”
青帝喃喃自语。
“影一！”
随后，青帝突然开口。
而青帝后方，本就空无一人，但是此刻突然出现一道低沉沙哑的声音。
“在！”
“你派几名影子，多观察一下洛家小丫头和十一皇子！”
“是，陛下！”
沙哑的声音消失，青帝再次闭上了眼睛修炼。
下一刻，只见九天青龙虚影围绕青帝周身长吟。
此刻，青帝宛若天地之主，一呼一吸之间，天地之力都在暴动。
而青帝身上也爆发出了远超陆地神仙境界的强大力量。
元秀殿，回到自己房间，把宫女赶出去，陆尘感悟着自己的陆地神仙境界的力量和无上剑体的详细属性，
【无上剑体：剑道至尊体质，拥有无上剑体，领悟剑道神通毫无瓶颈，可直达剑道至尊，成就一代剑仙，更可引的天地万剑齐鸣，面对敌人剑道攻击，剑为加身，剑道之力自动削弱三分！】
“恐怖，恐怖至极！”
content_en:
Lu Chen hummed a little tune and returned to Yuanxiu Hall, where he saw his mother doing needlework with her head down and preparing clothes for the winter.
Although the imperial court was responsible for the food and clothing of the concubines and princes in the palace, in Concubine Yuan's view, only the clothes she sewed for her son were warmer.
Seeing this scene, Lu Chen couldn't help but feel a hint of warmth on his face.
Reborn into this world, from birth to now.
It means that the woman in front of you truly loves and treats herself.
Although for Lu Chen, a time traveler, Concubine Yuan is considered a cheap lady.
But this woman's love for him was true, and Lu Chen's heart had already been warmed even if it was made of iron.
"Chen'er is back. Are you hungry? There are some snacks here. Eat some."
Seeing Lu Chen, Concubine Yuan spoke with a doting smile on her face.
"Mother!"
Lu Chen came to Yuan Fei's side. He hugged Concubine Yuan's arm.
"Mother, tomorrow I will test my physique, foundation and understanding. Chen'er will definitely work hard to let the people in the palace and let the father see my child. The child will work harder to practice and become stronger. In the future, no one can look down on mother when the child is around!"
Lu Chen spoke sincerely.
When Concubine Yuan heard this, she was stunned for a moment, and then with tears in her eyes, she hugged Lu Chen tightly, with a smile of relief and happiness on her face.
"Chen'er, as far as my mother is concerned, as long as you are good, you are better than anything else!"
【Congratulations. Mission accomplished and a genuine smile on your mother's face. 】
[Congratulations, you have obtained the Supreme Sword Body! 】
At this time, Lu Chen heard a voice that only he could hear again.
Along with this voice, a terrifying sword intent suddenly erupted from Lu Chen's body.
At this moment, countless swords throughout the palace chanted excitedly for a second.
It was very short and didn't attract much attention.
But in the Zhongji Hall, the Qing Emperor who was practicing suddenly opened his eyes, and saw that the supreme treasure Qing Emperor Sword, which had been following him for decades in battles, groaned inexplicably, and the Qing Emperor frowned slightly.
"It's strange that there were two strange phenomena today. The most important thing is that I couldn't even detect it. What happened in my palace?"
Qingdi murmured to himself.
"Shadow One!"
Then, Qingdi suddenly spoke.
There was no one behind Qing Emperor, but at this moment a low and hoarse voice suddenly appeared.
"Here!"
"Send a few shadows to take a closer look at the Luo family's little girl and the eleventh prince!"
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
The hoarse voice disappeared, and Qingdi closed his eyes again to practice.
The next moment, the phantom of the Nine Heavens Green Dragon was seen surrounding the Qing Emperor.
At this moment, Qing Emperor was like the lord of heaven and earth. Every time he breathed and breathed, the power of heaven and earth was rioting.
And Qingdi also burst out with powerful power that far exceeded the realm of land gods.
In Yuanxiu Palace, he returned to his room and kicked out the palace maid. Lu Chen realized the power of his land fairy realm and the detailed attributes of the supreme sword body.
[Supreme Sword Body: The physique of the supreme swordsman. With the supreme sword body, there is no bottleneck in comprehending the magical power of the sword. It can directly reach the supreme swordsman and become a generation of swordsmen. It can also lead to the sound of thousands of swords in the world. When facing the enemy's sword attack, the sword will be added to the body, and the power of the sword will be automatically weakened by three points! 】
"Horrible, extremely terrifying!"
